history_summary: Add two species-reference GTDB correspondences to the RH1 consortium
history_details: The selected Streptomyces rochei and Streptomyces griseoincarnatus species-ID routes report reference populations 15/fraction 0.87 and 4/fraction 1.0. These populations do not identify the genomes of source stocks IT and SC; their cited source accessions are 16S identifiers. Preserve SPA2 and Herb native-null statuses, all four stocks, the pathway discussion and the distinction between glyphosate removal and filtered TOC without a carbon-balance claim. Only the two GTDB blocks/statuses and two native inline events change. Full scientific review, source-snippet coverage and corpus QC remain separate.
